text: The initiative is part of a larger Development Policy Operation series, with the first operation approved in 2022. It focuses on boosting private sector competitiveness through streamlined business registration and expanded access to finance for SMEs, strengthening fiscal resilience by enhancing public-private partnership management, and protecting vulnerable households by extending social protection mechanisms. Additionally, it emphasizes improved environmental regulation and disaster risk management to support sustainable growth.

metadata.solution_name: Second Cambodia Growth and Resilience Development Policy Financing
